form: predicted in-situ = isolated / (W x F); F = exposure(mu_isolated) / exposure(mu_in_situ); exposure(mu) = (1 - mu^p)^((p-1)/p); mu = memory-bound time fraction, taken as the achieved bandwidth over the bus share the kernel actually had

isolated_grid_confound.note: The pooled achieved-GB/s slope in the isolated grid is confounded with the width axis. Where the within-width sign is not stable, the pooled slope is a between-width effect and cannot be read as a bandwidth law.

rule58_launched_volume.note: not measured: the isolated cell of this pair was never published

published_pair_inversion.note: One published pair is enough to calibrate the in-situ point. A second pair is a held-out check, not extra precision.

alphonse_back_check.note: The composite C is applied to alphonse's shipped isolated number. The alphonse pair also calibrates the in-situ point, so this is a consistency check of the composite, not an independent test.

e124.note: no correction. Rule 69: E124 was measured in situ, so the frame term is already paid and applying it again would double count.
